message.content:
A standard **Big Mac** sold at McDonald’s contains roughly **≈ 550 kcal** (about 2,300 joules) per sandwich.  
That figure comes from U.S. nutrition labels where each Big Mac lists:

| Component | Calories |
|-----------|----------|
| Two 1‑oz beef patties | ~200 kcal |
| Special Sauce (½ cup) | ~100 kcal |
| Lettuce & Pickles | <10 kcal |
| Cheese slice | ~50 kcal |
| Sesame‑seed bun (two halves) | ~190–210 kcal |

Adding them up gives approximately **545–555 kcal**, which most sources round to **~550 kcal**.

> *Note:* Calorie counts can vary slightly between regions because ingredients and portion sizes differ. For example, some international menus list the Big Mac at 530–570 kcal. If you’re tracking macros precisely, check your local McDonald’s website or ask staff for the exact nutrition label.*
